ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution. Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and basal regions with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes and distal trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central nexus consists of a contiguous dark pigmentation zone extending from the peduncle to the notch. Lateral lobes exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds populated with high-density, low-intensity mottling. Notable high-contrast geometry includes a prominent dark circular/oval feature on the upper-left lobe and a thick vertical dark band on the upper-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation with a sharp convergence point; estimated internal angle between 45-60 degrees relative to lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire span. Substantial pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) observed at the distal tips; moderate-frequency peaks and valleys along the mid-lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapering distal tips; leading edges exhibit a standard convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Fine-grained high-intensity punctate clusters distributed within the dark central pigmentation; high-density dark spotting (mottling) scattered across the white lateral lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, heavy-gauge vertical linear mark on the right lobe; multiple fine-gauge horizontal and diagonal scratches distributed across both lobes, breaking the pigmentation continuity.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular/elliptical marking on the upper-left lobe resembling a ring or eye-like scar. Significant thick, dark vertical rake mark or trauma scar on the right lobe distal quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'fish-shaped' or 'eye-shaped' pigmentation/scarring complex on the left lobe; highly irregular, jagged terminal tips on both fluke lobes.
